overview: The Medford City Council considered ordinance amendments for ARPA-funded personnel positions, approved a trail easement for the Clippership Connector project, and recognized retiring School Committee member Paulette Van der Kloot as well as departing Councilors John Falco and Michael Marks.

items.title: Committee Reports
items.summary: The council accepted reports from previous Committee of the Whole meetings regarding the tax rate and federal funds.

items.title: Commendation of Paulette Van der Kloot
items.summary: The council approved a resolution congratulating Paulette Van der Kloot on her retirement following 32 years of service on the Medford School Committee.

items.title: ARPA Personnel Ordinance Amendments
items.summary: The council voted individually on proposed classification and compensation amendments for ARPA-funded positions, approving filled roles on first reading while tabling vacant positions.

items.title: Clippership Connector Easement to DCR
items.summary: The council approved granting a bike and pedestrian trail easement to the Department of Conservation and Recreation for the Clippership Connector project.

items.title: Commendation for Stella Tanaglia
items.summary: The council approved a resolution extending 90th birthday wishes to long-time resident Stella Tanaglia.

items.title: Public Participation and Councilor Farewells
items.summary: Members of the public addressed the council regarding tax assessments at Lawrence Memorial Hospital, and councilors offered farewell tributes to retiring Councilors John Falco and Michael Marks.

items.title: Approval of Meeting Records
items.summary: The council approved the meeting records.
